verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is community-sourced. One user describes typing "calc" into the Ubuntu Dash to launch apps, with imperfect ranking that puts LibreOffice Calc above Calculator, which shows a type-to-find app launcher exists. The Unity HUD comment covers menu-item search, an adjacent feature, and Unity has since been replaced by GNOME Shell, so it is unclear the current desktop is what's evidenced. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a global search launcher, evidence of file search, evidence of settings search, evidence that the current GNOME-based desktop provides this, and evidence of instant or well-ranked results.
